plotSections.title: The Portal Leads Near Langdale
bullets: The party examined the forest beyond the open portal. Dana recognized the flora and fauna as matching the area around Langdale, though she could not be certain of the exact location from the nighttime view.

Walker used his experience traveling with his bees to investigate. He recognized a distinctive old, oddly angled tree that he had encountered during one of his previous bee-related journeys, confirming that the portal opens somewhere in the vicinity of Langdale.

The party realized that the portal appears to provide a route very close to home, but Dana and Sylan emphasized that they should not immediately leave before dealing with their new responsibilities and understanding what has happened.

plotSections.title: Gerk's New Responsibility and Portal Control
bullets: Gerk is currently responsible for an open portal connecting two locations and is learning that opening and closing these powerful doors may not be straightforward.
The DM warned Gerk that closing the current portal could make it difficult to reopen a portal to the exact same location later. He strongly recommended closing it rather than leaving it open.
The warning was reinforced by reference to past incidents where opened doors allowed dangerous creatures or bugs to come through, making the party cautious about leaving portals unattended.

plotSections.title: The Party Regroups
bullets: Sylan recognized that the group had just gained a major responsibility and suggested that everyone take a moment to organize themselves and process what they had learned.
Sylan spent time reflecting on the Raven Queen's earlier conversation and intended to record the information in the party's notes.
The party began winding down with drinks and discussed potentially visiting a tavern after finishing their business. These plans were largely social and did not reveal new story information.

personality: Continues to use humor while dealing with the seriousness of his new portal responsibilities.
